sources.citation: De Schutter, Minimal state-space realization in linear system theory: an overview, Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics (2000)
Jakubczyk, Existence and Uniqueness of Realizations of Nonlinear Systems, SIAM Journal on Control and Optimization
Al-Falou and Trummer, Identifiability of Recurrent Neural Networks, Econometric Theory (2003)

findings.finding: Minimal dynamical and recurrent realizations can have non-unique internal coordinates while preserving the same input-output behavior: LTI minimal realizations are unique only up to similarity transformation, nonlinear minimal realizations can be diffeomorphic under standard conditions, and recurrent networks can be observationally equivalent. Native route/state coordinate identity is therefore not generally an input-output invariant.
findings.impact: Future broad H7 route/state claims should either demonstrate invariance under admissible reparameterizations using intervention-anchored semantics or explicitly scope the claim to an equivalence class of realizations.

sources.citation: Iakymchuk et al., Numerical reproducibility for the parallel reduction on multi- and many-core architectures, Parallel Computing (2015)
Impacts of floating-point non-associativity on reproducibility for HPC and deep learning applications, SC24-W / IEEE (2024)
Pinto, Alguacil and Bauerheim, On the reproducibility of fully convolutional neural networks for modeling time-space-evolving physical systems, Data-Centric Engineering (2022)

findings.finding: Exact dependency and package provenance does not alone guarantee bitwise or numerically deterministic execution because floating-point reduction order and parallel execution can vary, and recurrent/time-evolving rollouts can amplify small numerical differences.
findings.impact: H7 should keep software-environment reproducibility and numerical execution determinism as separate properties. The current R4 single-thread/hash-seed mitigations are positive but do not by themselves prove that every protected execution path is numerically deterministic.

sources.citation: Rampin et al., ReproZip: The Reproducibility Packer, JOSS (2016)
Complete Provenance for Application Experiments with Containers and Hardware Interface Metadata, CANOPIE-HPC (2022)
Solarin et al., Reproducibility is Not Enough: Artifact Verifiability in Decentralized-Build Package Ecosystems (2026)

findings.finding: Reproducing an environment and independently verifying how an artifact was produced are distinct requirements. Independent verification benefits from source-state, build-environment, dependency, build-instruction and hardware-interface provenance rather than trusting a producer summary alone.
findings.impact: R4's exact wheel hashes, source-component blobs and host binding are aligned with this stronger provenance model, but this remains evidence-integrity closure rather than mechanism evidence.

findings.finding: Content-addressed functional package environments such as Guix/Nix provide a stronger reproducibility model by deriving environments from explicit dependency graphs and immutable inputs.
findings.impact: This is a prospective SYSTEM/provenance ceiling only. It does not justify changing the frozen H7 R4 package/resource choice after the current object has been prospectively fixed.
